# netactuate_bgp_prefixes (Data Source)

Reads BGP Prefixes visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_bgp_prefixes" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `group_type` (String) BGP group type filter. The API defaults this to anycast when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `prefixes` (List of Object) BGP prefixes visible to the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prefixes))

<a id="nestedatt--prefixes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prefixes`

Read-Only:

- `agreement_id` (Number)
- `anycast_profile` (Number)
- `asn_id` (Number)
- `bgp_prefix_id` (Number)
- `group_id` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `prefix` (String)
